mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_account (asset_code, asset_name, spec, unit, stock_num, price, manufacturer) VALUES (#{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{stockNum}, #{price}, #{manufacturer})
mapper.select:
SELECT aa.id, aa.asset_code, aa.asset_name, aa.spec, aa.unit, aa.stock_num, aa.price, aa.manufacturer, aa.update_time FROM asset_account aa LEFT JOIN asset_item ai ON aa.asset_code = ai.asset_code LEFT JOIN asset_category ac ON ai.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN asset_category ac2 ON ac.parent_id = ac2.id LEFT JOIN asset_category ac1 ON ac2.parent_id = ac1.id WHERE 1=1
AND aa.asset_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{assetCode}, '%')
AND aa.asset_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{assetName}, '%')
AND aa.spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{spec}, '%')
AND aa.manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{manufacturer}, '%')
AND ac1.id = #{level1Id}
AND ac2.id = #{level2Id}
AND ac.id = #{categoryId}
AND aa.stock_num > 0
AND (aa.stock_num = 0 OR aa.stock_num IS NULL)
ORDER BY aa.asset_code

SELECT s.storage_no AS storageNo, COALESCE(s.order_no, '') AS orderNo, COALESCE(s.apply_no, '') AS applyNo, MAX(s.create_time) AS createTime, SUM(sd.storage_quantity) AS storageQuantity FROM asset_in_storage_detail sd INNER JOIN asset_in_storage s ON sd.storage_id = s.id WHERE sd.asset_code = #{assetCode} AND sd.storage_quantity > 0 GROUP BY s.storage_no, s.order_no, s.apply_no ORDER BY MAX(s.create_time) DESC

SELECT rm.receive_no AS receiveNo, MAX(rd.create_time) AS createTime, SUM(rd.receive_num) AS receiveQuantity FROM asset_receive_detail rd INNER JOIN asset_receive_main rm ON rd.receive_id = rm.id WHERE rd.asset_code = #{assetCode} AND rd.receive_num > 0 GROUP BY rm.receive_no ORDER BY MAX(rd.create_time) DESC
